tolerance.policy: root-approved engineering gate fixed before first GPU run; no caller override; not an official certification
tolerance.officialReference: OCIO2.6 forward GPU fixture uses2e-5 absolute/relative=false; reported separately for this extended sample set

limits: Calls the optional production output module; its accurate-atan numerical change is explicitly non-official. The original official OCIO2.6 CPU outputs are unchanged independent expectations.
Only owned RGBA32F targets are drawn. No new canvas, production main-surface draw/resize, Windows setting or source/exposure policy change.
963 samples per target include declared AP1 input/output range policies; this is not certification of the bare unbounded FixedFunction for arbitrary RGB.
17 admission anchors are additional actual prepare-time GPU checks, not a substitute for all963.
Current actual DPR and nonzero physical-pixel viewport are checked. A true DPR2 rerun must be made by the caller; this fixture does not fake DPR or resize the main backbuffer.
Existing GL error flags are recorded and drained at entry; error-queue consumption cannot be restored. Owned operation errors are recorded separately. Driver/Three presentation state is restored.
No native HDR bridge/WebGPU/panel-nit/visual acceptance or whole-scene FPS claim. No GPU performance query is performed.
